criteria.name: Establishing contact
criteria.definition: The operator greeted the customer in the customer's language and introduced themselves in the first response.

options.definition: Greeted in the customer's language and introduced themselves in the first operator response.
Failed to properly greet or introduce themselves.

sub_checks.question: Does the first OPERATOR message contain a greeting?
Does the first OPERATOR message contain the operator's name or self-introduction?
Is the first OPERATOR message in the same language the client used?

criteria.name: Identifying customer needs
criteria.definition: The operator considered the information already provided by the customer and clarified missing information before answering.

options.definition: Considered given information and clarified missing information before answering.
Failed to clarify important missing information when clarification was necessary.

criteria.na_condition: the information already available was sufficient to answer the customer's request

criteria.name: Identification
criteria.definition: Customer identity verification was completed before disclosing protected information or performing a protected action.

options.definition: Verification completed before the protected disclosure or action (check message order).
Verification was required but not confirmed before the protected action or disclosure.

criteria.na_condition: the customer's request did not require identity verification (e.g. a general question about tariffs)

criteria.name: Correct and complete consultation
criteria.definition: Correctness and completeness of the operator's consultation.

options.definition: All important questions were answered, or an appropriate next step was provided.
The main question was resolved, but a secondary detail was missed.
Only part of the request was resolved; an important question remained unanswered.
General guidance was provided, but the customer still does not understand what to do.
No meaningful answer was provided, or the key recommendation was incorrect.

criteria.na_condition: the conversation ended before the customer formulated their request

channel_notes.voice: Evaluate whether questions were answered, whether information was correct and complete, whether necessary actions were explained, and whether any incorrect information was given.

criteria.name: Empathy and customer orientation
criteria.definition: The operator communicated politely and, when the customer expressed dissatisfaction or described an inconvenience, responded to the specific problem.

options.definition: Polite throughout, and responded to the specific problem when the customer expressed dissatisfaction.
Failed to demonstrate appropriate politeness or to respond to the customer's expressed problem.

criteria.name: Conversation management, speed and communication quality
criteria.definition: Communication clarity, response organization, and warning the customer about waiting time when necessary.

options.definition: Responses are clear and coherent; if there was an obvious waiting period, the operator informed the customer.
One noticeable communication problem occurred, but the customer could still understand and continue.
The customer had to ask additional questions because of unclear wording or poor organization.
Incoherent or contradictory responses made the conversation difficult to understand.

channel_notes.voice: Evaluate logical flow, clarity, absence of inappropriate expressions, correct wording and pause management. Do NOT judge speech speed, diction or pronunciation from a text transcript.

criteria.name: Conversation conclusion
criteria.definition: The operator summarized the result or offered further assistance, and said goodbye.

options.definition: Summarized the result or offered further assistance, and said goodbye.
Failed to properly conclude the conversation when there was an opportunity.

criteria.na_condition: the conversation ended unexpectedly before the operator had an opportunity to conclude it

criteria.name: Serious violations
criteria.definition: Insulting or offensive behaviour toward the customer; offering paid services outside the company (including asking the customer to transfer money personally to the operator, or asking for the customer's personal number to provide paid private consultation — the offer alone is enough); disclosing confidential information.

options.definition: At least one listed violation is present (quote it).
None of the listed violations is present.
